name: Gonorrhoea (uncomplicated)
advice: No sex for 7 days after both you and your partner (last 60 days) are treated. Tests: HIV, VDRL/TPHA; culture with sensitivity if possible; throat infection needs a test of cure at 7–14 days. Retest at 3 months because reinfection is common.

ref: Wolverton 4e ch 9; CDC STI 2021 (NACO kit 1 alternative: cefixime 400 mg + azithromycin 1 g)

rx.instr: Chlamydia cover unless excluded by NAAT; in pregnancy use azithromycin 1 g single dose instead
